summary: Martin Marietta Materials filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026 reporting that on September 15, 2026 it and wholly-owned Martin Marietta Funding LLC executed the Eighteenth Amendment to their April 19, 2013 Credit and Security Agreement with Truist Bank as administrative agent. The amendment extends the scheduled maturity of the $500 million trade receivables securitization facility to September 15, 2027, permits an increase to $700 million subject to lender commitments, and reprices borrowings to Adjusted Term SOFR plus 0.700%. This is a routine credit-facility extension with no change of control, tender, or strategic event; no arbitrage angle.
